This will enable US government and public sector organizations with FedRAMP requirements to run regulated Oracle AI Database workloads using Oracle Exadata Database Service on Dedicated Exadata Infrastructure in AWS GovCloud (US), Microsoft Azure Government, and Google Cloud Assured Workloads.
